sentence_stem: If she had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: she would be ready for the exam now.
full_sentence: If she had studied harder last year, she would be ready for the exam now.
acceptable_variants: she would be better prepared now.
she would not be struggling now.

options.text: she will be ready for the exam now.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future result, not the imagined result of an unreal past condition.
This repeats a past fact instead of giving the imagined result of the unreal condition.

options.text: she would be ready for the exam now.
she is ready for the exam now.
options.why_wrong: This states a present fact and ignores the hypothetical past condition set up by 'if'.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past unreal condition with a present unreal result
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition with an unreal present result. Ukrainian speakers often mirror the past condition in the result clause, but English requires a 'would' form with a present time reference.
translation: Якби вона більше вчилася минулого року, зараз вона була б готова до іспиту.
